protocol.coldMeaning: fresh worker/runtime with already-installed local assets; OS caches and process caches may be warm; no network/download timing
protocol.sizesMeaning: sum of specified runtime asset bytes and independent gzip/brotli compression; excludes application integration, optional packages and network headers
protocol.memoryMeaning: Node worker thread counters plus process-wide RSS; diagnostic only, not a browser peak-memory ranking
protocol.inputMeaning: buffered input plus separate Node SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics.wait diagnostic; this is not proof of browser/WebView input portability
protocol.bridgeMeaning: mock arithmetic/sensor, delay and explicit async ask callbacks only; no actual simulator/VM/hardware integration tested

coverage.browser: separate browser-probe.mjs report; do not infer from Node
